candidate_workaround: Read all staged Git blobs through one bounded cat-file batch session and build both manifests from that in-memory map.
failure_signature: The first closeout manifest build exceeded its thirty-second wrapper while launching a separate Git process for each indexed blob and produced no manifest outputs.
recurrence_guard: Estimate process-launch complexity before exact-manifest generation and use one cat-file batch session for bounded multi-blob reads.
rollback: Give the timed-out build zero manifest or pass credit, retain its failure, and remove no evidence before a bounded batch implementation passes.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded Git plumbing recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, privacy-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Batch exact Git-index blob reads after manifest timeout
trigger_preconditions: An exact manifest builder exceeds its wrapper because per-blob Git process launches dominate the bounded envelope.
